verdict.rationale: Okta's Cross App Access (XAA) is described as a way to build secure agent-to-app connections over OIDC. It aims to let an AI-powered app act for a user without exposing credentials, while keeping administrative control, which points toward controlled delegated access for agents. However, the pack never explicitly describes issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials (scopes, token restrictions, per-agent permissions), so the capability is only implied. missing for 10: explicit documentation of scoped/least-privilege token or credential issuance for agents, details on scope granularity and admin policy controls, independent or hands-on corroboration.
